RAJYA  SABHA
————
List of Questions for ORAL ANSWERS
to be asked at a sitting of the Rajya Sabha to be held on
Wednesday,  the March 21, 2007/Phalguna 30, 1928 (Saka)
————
(Ministries: Commerce and Industry; Defence; Home Affairs; Information and
Broadcasting; Labour and Employment; Parliamentary Affairs;
Rural Development; Textiles)
Total number of questions — 20
102
†Original notice of the question received in Hindi.
Facilities to big companies in retail
trade
†*321. SHRI JANESHWAR
MISHRA: Will the Minister of
COMMERCE AND INDUSTRY be
pleased to state:
(a) the facilities provided to the big
companies of the world which run chains
of malls in retail trade;
(b) the financial burden, Government
will have to bear to provide these facilities;
(c) the measures taken by Government
to check the monopoly of multinational
and other big retail companies in respect of
local vegetables, fruits, grains, etc.; and
(d) how the small retail traders of the
country would be provided relief by these
measures?
Objections to membership
verification of Central Trade Unions
*322. SHRI TAPAN KUMAR SEN:
Will the Minister of LABOUR AND
EMPLOYMENT be pleased to state:
(a) whether some Central Trade Unions
have raised objections to the verification
process and have demanded a meeting of
the Committee which was monitoring the
work of verification of membership of
Central Trade Unions;
(b) if so, the names of the organizations
asking for such a meeting;
(c) whether Government convened such
a meeting; and
(d) if not, the reasons therefor?
Labour force
†*323. DR. MURLI MANOHAR
JOSHI:
SHRI RAM JETHMALANI:
Will the Minister of LABOUR AND
EMPLOYMENT be pleased to state:
(a) whether it is a fact that entire labour
force is engaged in agriculture, industries,
trade and service sector in the country;
(b) if not, the facts in this regard;
(c) total labour force engaged in each of
the said sectors during the year 2001-02 in
the country;
(d) areas identified during the years from
2001-02 to 2005-06 where the percentage
of such labour force has been less or more;
and

103
†Original notice of the question received in Hindi.
(e) to what extent percentage of such
labour force has been less or more?
Status of SGSY
†*324. SHRI ALI ANWAR: Will the
Minister of RURAL DEVELOPMENT be
pleased to state:
(a) the status of Swarnjayanti Gram
Swarojgar Yojana (SGSY) in the country,
State-wise;
(b) the number of self-help groups of
various grades like first, second and third,
State-wise, alongwith the status of
collective and individual skill and
entrepreneurship;
(c) the status of federations, State-wise,
alongwith the works carried out by them;
(d) the State-wise details of the amount
spent on development of skill and
infrastructure, alongwith the State-wise
proportion of SCs/STs and OBCs among
the beneficiaries;
(e) the details of the participation of
Dalits and Muslim community in this
scheme; and
(f) the State-wise number of NABARD,
NGO and District Rural Development
Agency (DRDA)/District Rural Develop-
ment Cell (DRDC) operated and funded
self-help groups?
Houses destroyed during Tsunami
*325. SHRI KALRAJ MISHRA: Will
the Minister of HOME AFFAIRS be
pleased to state:
(a) the number of houses in each State,
destroyed or damaged during the Tsunami
havoc, which have still to be reconstructed/
repaired;
(b) the total number of such houses
rebuilt or repaired; and
(c) the reasons for the slow
rehabilitation of the Tsunami hit persons?
Central assistance to heavy rain
affected Rajasthan
†*326. SHRI LALIT KISHORE
CHATURVEDI: Will the Minister of
HOME AFFAIRS be pleased to state:
(a) whether the Central study team
recently visited the heavy rainfall affected
12 districts of Rajasthan and assessed the
situation there;
(b) whether the Central Government
have released total amount of Rs. 350 crore
and Rs. 163.66 crore, till date; and
(c) whether the memorandum of the
State Government has been considered; if
so, by when the funds would be made
available according to the demand?
Unemployed citizens in
the country
*327. SHRI VIJAYKUMAR RUPANI:
Will the Minister of LABOUR AND
EMPLOYMENT be pleased to state:
(a) the number of unemployed citizens
in the country, as on 31st March, 2006,
State-wise;
(b) the number of citizens who have
been able to get employment, State-wise,
from 2002-03 to 2005-06;
(c) whether it is a fact that nearly one
crore youth enter into job market in the
country every year;
(d) whether it is also a fact that many
regular employees in the organized sector
had to lose their jobs due to technological
changes during the above period; and
(e) if so, the details thereof?

104
†Original notice of the question received in Hindi.
Conflicts due to acquisition of
agricultural land
†*328. SHRI PYARELAL
KHANDELWAL: Will the Minister of
COMMERCE AND INDUSTRY be
pleased to state:
(a) whether it is a fact that owing to
acquisition of land and non-payment of
adequate compensation package to the
farmers therefor, a number of cases of
conflict between farmers and the
administration have come to light in various
States;
(b) if so, the details thereof;
(c) whether Government have
formulated any national scheme to prevent
such conflicts;
(d) if so, the details thereof; and
(e) the details regarding the area of
agricultural land acquired for setting up of
industries during last three years, State-
wise?
Expenditure on internal security
†*329. SHRI SHREEGOPAL VYAS:
SHRI AJAY MAROO:
Will the Minister of HOME AFFAIRS
be pleased to state:
(a) the expenditure on maintenance of
internal security and peace during the last
three years, year-wise and State-wise;
(b) the percentage of this sum to the
general budget;
(c) the policies being formulated with a
view to decrease this expenditure gradually;
and
(d) whether the assistance of the
opposition and the States is being obtained
for determination of this policy; if so, the
details thereof?
Trade relations with China, France,
Japan and Portugal
*330. SHRI M.V. MYSURA REDDY:
Will the Minister of COMMERCE AND
INDUSTRY be pleased to state:
(a) the details of bilateral relations of
Indo-China, Indo-French, Indo-Japan and
Indo-Portugal in the field of trade and
industries;
(b) the details of investments made in
the country under India's economic reforms
policy by US, Japan, France, etc., during
the last three years, State-wise; and
(c) the necessary steps/initiatives taken
by Government to attract US, Japan and
other countries for making investments in
the country?
Legalising the betting
*331. SHRI MAHENDRA MOHAN:
Will the Minister of HOME AFFAIRS be
pleased to state:
(a) whether Government intend to make
betting legal in the country, in view of the
huge sums of money involved in it;
(b) if so, the views of Government in
this regard; and
(c) if not, how the betting in the country
is going to be tackled?
Media reports on performance of
DRDO
*332. SHRI HARISH RAWAT:
SHRI SANTOSH BAGRODIA:
Will the Minister of DEFENCE be
pleased to state:
(a) whether Government have taken
note of certain recent media reports on the
performance of Defence Research and
Development Organisation (DRDO);

105
(b) if so, whether Government share
the assessment of such reports;
(c) whether Government consider that
such report might undermine the overall
achievements of DRDO in defence sector
and influence the public perception;
(d) whether Government have
ascertained the reasons for such one-sided
media reporting; if so, the details thereof;
and
(e) the steps taken by Government to
correct the media and public perception on
DRDO's achievements, without
undermining the morale of DRDO
scientists?
Persons registered in J&K under
NREGS
*333. CHOWDHARY MOHAM-
MAD ASLAM : W ill the Minister of
RURAL DEVELOPMENT be pleased to
state:
(a) the number of persons registered
upto 31st December, 2006 in J&K, district-
wise, under National Rural Employment
Guarantee Scheme;
(b) the number, out of them, who were
given employment upto 31st December,
2006, district-wise, with the actual number
of days for which employment was given
on average, and the daily wages paid to
each worker for the period from 2nd
February to 31st December, 2006;
(c) the extent of funds given by the
Central Government for the purpose;
(d) the extent to which those funds were
utilized; and
(e) whether the unutilized funds would
be carried over to the next year and if not,
whether they would lapse?
Self-employed women in the country
†*334. SHRIMATI SUSHMA
SWARAJ: Will the Minister of LABOUR
AND EMPLOYMENT be pleased to
state:
(a) the total population of women in
the country as per the census carried out
during the year 2001 and the details of self-
employed women, among them;
(b) whether employment opportunities
for women have increased during the last
three years; and
(c) if so, by how much?
Atrocities against STs
*335. DR. GY AN PRAKASH
PILANIA : Will the Minister of HOME
AFFAIRS be pleased to state:
(a) total incidence of atrocities against
Scheduled Tribes (F.I.Rs), incidence per 10
lac population, total increase, numerical and
percentage, disposal thereof, during last
five years, States and UTs, year-wise;
(b) the first four States in the country
having worst scenario of  atrocities against
STs on the basis of total high incidence as
per 10 lac population, poor attention %,
poor conviction %, yearly high increase%;
(c) whether Government feel that
atrocities against STs, scenario in India is
alarming in the light of above statistics; and
(d) if so, what measures Government
intend to take?
Seizure of arms and explosives by
coast guard
†*336.  SHRI MOTILAL VORA:
SHRIMATI S.G. INDIRA:
Will the Minister of DEFENCE be
pleased to state:
(a) the details of quantum of
†Original notice of the question received in Hindi.

106
†Original notice of the question received in Hindi.
objectionable goods/weapons recovered
from coastal areas of Tamil Nadu by Indian
Coast Guard from January 2006, till date;
(b) the countries from where these
weapons were procured/being sent to; and
(c) the steps being taken by
Government to check the same?
Improving village infrastructure
*337. SHRI RAVULA CHANDRA
SEKAR REDDY: W ill the Minister of
RURAL DEVELOPMENT be pleased to
state:
(a) whether Government are improving
village infrastructure;
(b) if so, the details thereof, State-wise,
during the last three years;
(c) the amount allocated and utilized
for the same; and
(d) the criteria being adopted to select
villages in each State?
Export of wheat and onion
*338. SHRI AMAR SINGH:
SHRI ABU ASIM AZMI:
Will the Minister of COMMERCE
AND INDUSTRY be pleased to state:
(a) what quantity of wheat and onion
has been exported during the year 2006,
alongwith the per quintal rates of these
commodities;
(b) whether Government are aware that
there had been abnormal rise in the prices
of these commodities on account of the
said export; and
(c) whether Government propose to ban
the export of these commodities and if not,
the reasons therefor?
Security cover to religious and
cultural places
†*339. DR. PRABHA THAKUR: Will
the Minister of HOME AFFAIRS be
pleased to state:
(a) whether Government have
formulated a plan to provide special
security cover to some of the important
religious and cultural places of the country;
(b) if so, the places identified under the
said plan; and
(c) the criterion adopted for above
identification, alongwith the details of the
budget provision Government have kept
for security of these places?
BSF jawans living in mud houses
†*340. SHRI AJAY MAROO: Will the
Minister of HOME AFFAIRS be pleased
to state:
(a) whether it is a fact that the jawans
of Border Security Force, posted on the
borders in Tanot, almost 120 km away from
Jaisalmer in Rajasthan, have to live in mud
houses;
(b) whether it is also a fact that due to
this, the jawans have to face difficulties;
and
(c) if so, whether Government would
consider to build permanent concrete
houses for these jawans?
NEW DELHI; YOGENDRA NARAIN,
The 15th March, 2007 Secretary-General.

RAJYA  SABHA
————
List of Questions for  WRITTEN ANSWERS
to be asked at a sitting of the Rajya Sabha to be held on
Wednesday,  the March 21, 2007/Phalguna 30, 1928 (Saka)
————
(Ministries: Commerce and Industry; Defence; Home Affairs; Information and
Broadcasting; Labour and Employment; Parliamentary Affairs;
Rural Development; Textiles)
Total number of questions — 155
560
Insurance schemes for plantation
industry
2417. SHRIMATI SUPRIYA SULE:
Will the Minister of COMMERCE AND
INDUSTRY be pleased to state:
(a) whether a task force on plantation
industry has recommended a mix of
subsidy-based insurance scheme costing
Rs. 720 crore to the Exchequer and a
market-based scheme, to co-exist over a
period of five years, till the growers learn
to meet the risks of price movements, and
the art of price risk management;
(b) whether the task force has submitted
report to the Ministry;
(c) if so, what are the recommendations
and whether these recommendations have
been referred to Group of Ministers; and
(d) by when decision in this regard has
to be taken?
Japanese aid for development of
Industrial Corridor
2418. SHRIMATI SUPRIYA SULE:
Will the Minister of COMMERCE AND
INDUSTRY be pleased to state:
(a) whether Japan has agreed to help
India to develop an Industrial Corridor,
along the Delhi-Mumbai multi-modal
freight corridor;
(b) if so, whether the understanding was
reached during the discussions between
Commerce and Industry Minister and
Japan's Minister of Economy, Trade and
Industry in Tokyo, in December, 2006;
(c) if so, what are the main agreements
reached between the two countries; and
(d) what steps Government are
considering to take to implement the same?
SEZs in Rajasthan
2419. DR. GY AN PRAKASH
PILANIA: Will the Minister of
COMMERCE AND INDUSTRY be
pleased to state:
(a) the names of Special Economic
Zones (SEZs) and the area of land over
which each Zone is to be set up in Rajasthan;
(b) the promoter selected for each
Special Economic Zone;
(c) the investment by promoter and the
likely total investment in each Zones, Zone-
wise;

561
(d) the likely number of people to be
displaced and the compensation to be paid
to each person displaced, Zone-wise; and
(e) the details of concessions proposed
to be granted for SEZs by the Centre and
the State, and the likely revenue
implications of these concessions for the
Centre and the State, Zone-wise?
NHRC notice regarding displacement
of people due to SEZs
2420. SHRI V. HANUMANTHA
RAO: Will the Minister of COMMERCE
AND INDUSTRY be pleased to state:
(a) whether Government have received
a notice from the National Human Rights
Commission with regard to displacement
of millions of people due to Special
Economic Zones;
(b) the details thereof;
(c) what steps would be taken to try to
find an amicable and reasonable solution to
the issues raised through the NHRC;
(d) whether Government would go to
the root of the problem and try to ensure
that the contentions/issues related to SEZs
are removed and conditions changed; and
(e) steps proposed to avoid
confrontation with displaced victims?
FDI in retail in SEZs
2421. SHRI V. HANUMANTHA
RAO: Will the Minister of COMMERCE
AND INDUSTRY be pleased to state:
(a) whether it is a fact that Government
propose to allow 75 per cent FDI in retail
in SEZs;
(b) the details of the new policy to use
the SEZs to allow giant MNC retail firms
into the country, with no limits on
percentage of FDI;
(c) what are the gains in using SEZs to
allow all kinds of  business into the country;
and
(d) the steps proposed to review the
SEZ policy in small scale sector?
Foreign capital in agriculture and
agricultural farms
2422. SH RIMATI VIPLOVE
THAKUR: Will the Minister of
COMMERCE AND INDUSTRY be
pleased to state:
(a) whether it is a fact that Foreign
Exchange Management Act (FEMA)
does not permit deployment of foreign
capital in agriculture and agricultural
farms;
(b) if so, whether the Department of
Industrial Policy and Promotion is
considering a proposal for allowing overseas
Indians to buy farmhouses and plantations
on small scale;
(c) if so, the details thereof; and
(d) whether the proposal is fraught with
serious consequences of social, legal and
economic nature?
Acquisition of agricultural and waste
lands for SEZs
2423. SHRI RAJKUMAR DHOOT:
Will the Minister of COMMERCE AND
INDUSTRY be pleased to state:
(a) whether it is a fact that the fertile
agricultural land has been acquired,
alongwith the waste land, for setting up
of Special Economic Zones in different
States;
(b) if so, the details thereof;
(c) the estimated loss of production of
foodgrains and cereals due to change of land
use; and

562
(d) how it is proposed to make good of
loss in production of foodgrains and cereals?
Production and export of marine food
2424. SHRI RAJKUMAR DHOOT:
Will the Minister of COMMERCE AND
INDUSTRY be pleased to state:
(a) whether it is a fact that the quantum
of export of marine food has declined during
the last two years;
(b) if so, the details thereof and the
reasons therefor; and
(c) the steps being taken to increase the
production and export of marine food?
Reservation in the Private Sector
2425. SHRI PENUMALLI MADHU:
Will the Minister of COMMERCE AND
INDUSTRY be pleased to state:
(a) whether Government are
contemplating any Act, to provide
reservations in the Private Sector; and
(b) if not, the details as to how
Government are going to meet the share of
lost jobs of SCs and STs in Government
services?
Expansion of Indo-Russian bilateral
business
2426. SHRI KALRAJ MISHRA:
SHRI SANTOSH BAGRODIA:
Will the Minister of COMMERCE
AND INDUSTRY be pleased to state:
(a) whether the Governments of India
and Russia agreed to expand bilateral
business during the recent summit meetings;
if so, the details thereof;
(b) whether the issue of difficulties in
getting Russian visa by the Indian business
persons was raised during such meetings;
(c) if so, what was the response of the
leadership of Russia;
(d) whether Russia has agreed to
facilitate visa to Indian business persons;
and
(e) if so, the details thereof and by
when such an agreement would be
implemented?
Industrial parks on product segment
basis
2427. SHRIMATI S.G. INDIRA: Will
the Minister of COMMERCE AND
INDUSTRY be pleased to state:
(a) whether it is a fact that Government
are considering to set up industrial parks
on product segment basis;
(b) whether such industrial parks exist
in many developing countries and are
contributing foreign exchange immensely
to their economy; and
(c) if so, whether Government had made
any study in this regard?
Industrialization of North Eastern
Region
2428. SHRI O.T. LEPCHA: Will the
Minister of COMMERCE AND
INDUSTRY be pleased to state:
(a) whether Government have
formulated any effective policy to promote
industrialization in the North Eastern
Region, particularly in Sikkim;
(b) if so, the details thereof; and
(c) the details of amount invested in the
Region for this purpose during the last three
years?

563
†Original notice of the question received in Hindi.
Sector-specific FDI
2429. SHRIMATI N.P. DURGA: Will
the Minister of COMMERCE AND
INDUSTRY be pleased to state:
(a) whether Government propose to
allow sector-specific FDI;
(b) if so, whether any consultations by
Department of Industrial Policy and
Promotion with the Department of
Consumer Affairs have been held in this
regard;
(c) if so, the details thereof; and
(d) how allowing 51 per cent FDI in
single-branded retail would help to get
investments in the country?
Trade route through Bangladesh in
NER
2430. SHRI V. NARAYANASAMY:
Will the Minister of COMMERCE AND
INDUSTRY be pleased to state:
(a) whether it is a fact that Government
of India would benefit more by opening of
trade route through Bangladesh on North-
East border; and
(b) if so, whether Government have
considered the security angle while opening
of the trade between Bangladesh and North-
Eastern parts of India?
Commerce Ministers' meet at Davos
2431. SHRI SANTOSH
BAGRODIA:
SHRI GIREESH KUMAR
SANGHI:
SHRI MAHENDRA SAHNI:
Will the Minister of COMMERCE
AND INDUSTRY be pleased to state:
(a) the agenda of the recent meeting of
Commerce Ministers at Davos;
(b) the details of the conclusions of the
meeting;
(c) whether a decision was taken
regarding resumption of Doha Round;
(d) if so, on what conditions;
(e) whether India, alongwith other
partner developing countries, is expected
to relax its stand on agriculture; and
(f) if so, the details thereof, alongwith
the reasons for such relaxation?
Regulating the supply of coffee
†2432. SHRI BANWARI LAL
KANCHHAL: Will the Minister of
COMMERCE AND INDUSTRY be
pleased to state:
(a) the quantum of coffee produced,
exported and consumed during each of last
two years;
(b) the average demand of coffee in the
country, per year; and
(c) the steps taken by Government to
regulate the supply of coffee in the
country?
Banning non-serious parties from
getting SEZs
2433. SHRI S.M. LALJAN BASHA:
Will the Minister of COMMERCE AND
INDUSTRY be pleased to state:
(a) whether Government are aware that
clauses 3 (1) and (2) of the Special Economic
Zones Act, 2005 allow dis-reputable and
non-serious private parties to get SEZ
permits;
(b) whether it is a fact that the above
two clauses allow any favoured person and
pre-selected person to get SEZ clearances;

564
(c) if so, what steps would be taken to
amend or suspend those two clauses, to
ensure that SEZs are not given to people
with no standing; and
(d) the steps proposed to ban private
companies and people from exploiting
these clauses, to corner thousands of areas
of land next to cities?
Declaring some UTs as SEZs
2434. SHRI S.M. LALJAN BASHA:
Will the Minister of COMMERCE AND
INDUSTRY be pleased to state:
(a) whether Government are considering
proposals to declare some Union
Territories as Special Economic Zone (SEZ)
in to to;
(b) if so, the details of this novel scheme;
(c) the Union Territories under
consideration for this purpose;
(d) whether concurrence of such Union
Territories has been taken; and
(e) the Union Territories which have
sought States for their entire geographical
areas?
Demand for transparent SEZ policy
2435. SHRI C. RAMA-
CHANDRAIAH: Will the Minister of
COMMERCE AND INDUSTRY be
pleased to state:
(a) whether the associations of  industry
have demanded a transparent, consistent
and sustainable SEZ policy;
(b) if so, what steps are being taken to
revise the extant SEZ policy;
(c) the details of reasons for freezing/
going slow regarding the SEZ's at present;
and
(d) the details of SEZ's earmarked/given
permission in Andhra Pradesh and the
progress made in this direction?
Revival of SSI and medium scale sick
industries
2436. SHRI RAMDAS AGARWAL:
Will the Minister of COMMERCE AND
INDUSTRY be pleased to state:
(a) whether it is a fact that the sickness
in SSI and medium scale industries in the
country is increasing day-by-day;
(b) if so, what are the reasons therefor;
(c) what steps Government propose to
take or have taken so far, for revival of
industrial sickness in a time bound manner;
(d) the number of references made to
BIFR during each of the last three years,
indicating the number of industries
recommended so far for revival by BIFR,
State-wise, particularly in Rajasthan; and
(e) the number of such sick industries
revived during each of the last three years,
State-wise?
Popularity of Indian jewellery in
markets abroad
2437. SHRI RAMDAS AGARWAL:
Will the Minister of COMMERCE AND
INDUSTRY be pleased to state:
(a) whether it is a fact that Indian
jewellery is becoming more popular in
Europe, as well as in United States, and is
currently favoured niche in Western
market;
(b) if so, what was demand and supply
position in 2005-06, indicating the increased
percentage in demand, as compared to
export figures of 2004-05;

565
†Original notice of the question received in Hindi.
(c) what steps Government have taken
so far for development and popularising
Indian jewellery in world markets, including
imitation jewellery; and
(d) what incentives Government
propose to give to the makers of imitation
jewellery, Zari goods production, etc. in
the country?
Procurement of turmeric by NAFED
in A.P.
2438. SHRI SUDARSHAN
AKARAPU: Will the Minister of
COMMERCE AND INDUSTRY be
pleased to state:
(a) whether Government are aware of
the problems faced by the cultivators of
turmeric in Andhra Pradesh, on account of
steep fall in its prices;
(b) if so, the steps Government have
taken or propose to take to ameliorate the
problems of the farmers;
(c) whether Government have directed
the NAFED to start procurement of
turmeric from farmers at a remunerative
pice; if so, the details thereof; and
(d) if not, the reasons therefor?
Ban on multinational in retail trade
†2439. SHRI UDAY PRATAP
SINGH: Will the Minister of
COMMERCE AND INDUSTRY be
pleased to state:
(a) whether Government are considering
to ban the entry of multinational companies
in the retail trade, to strengthen the
domestic trade; and
(b) if so, the details thereof?
Smoking at common places
2440. SHRI ABU ASIM AZMI: Will
the Minister of COMMERCE AND
INDUSTRY be pleased to state:
(a) whether Union Government have
prohibited smoking at common places;
(b) whether chewing of tobacco at
common places is permitted;
(c) whether sale of cigarette, bidi, gutka,
etc. at common places is permitted;
(d) whether special facilities are
provided to the tobacco producers for
sowing it; and
(e) if so, the reasons for such a
discrimination with the smokers?
Growth rate of manufacturing sector
†2441. SHRI RAM JETHMALANI:
SHRI RAJ MOHINDER
SINGH MAJITHA:
Will the Minister of COMMERCE
AND INDUSTRY be pleased to state:
(a) whether an assessment regarding
annual growth rate of development in the
manufacturing sector of the country during
2005-06 and 2006-07, from April to
February has been made;
(b) if so, the annual growth rate of
